name: Management of Risk Practitioner
name_ja: リスクマネジメント (M_o_R) プラクティショナー

logistics.format: Open-book scenario-based objective testing exam (online proctored or testing centre)

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Scenario-based application after Foundation supports an associate risk practitioner; absent experience requirements and limited Japanese applicability restrain the professional signal despite the three-hour applied exam.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: The three-hour scenario-based open-book exam goes beyond risk vocabulary into bounded application. With no experience requirement and limited technical security content, it supports associate rather than independent professional delivery assurance.

alex-novak.rationale: The three-hour scenario assessment provides applied risk-framework reasoning beyond introductory awareness. With no experience requirement and no technical security delivery component, associate is the defensible level.
